title: Theme generator
summary: A theme from one colour: the main colour, the generator's own hue and chroma, a preview of the four theme palettes and a way back to SIMAI Framework's colour; it stores nothing and changes the page only with apply.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

value.description: The main colour, #rrggbb; empty while SIMAI Framework's own colour applies

hue.description: The generator's own hue; unset, the colour's

chroma.description: The generator's own chroma; unset, the colour's

swatches.description: The product's colours beside the picker, as sf-color takes them: #hex|Name, #hex

apply.description: Put the theme on target as inline variables at every change; without it the page is not changed

target.description: A CSS selector of the element apply themes; empty, the document's root

selector.description: The rule's selector in the events and in toCSS()

reset.summary: Back to SIMAI Framework's own colour; a committed choice

toCSS.summary: The theme as one stylesheet rule of its 64 primitives and 80 translucent steps (the four theme palettes), under the given selector or the `selector` attribute.

toJSON.summary: The theme object (simai.framework.theme.v1): source hue and chroma, and the four theme palettes' (primary, secondary, tertiary, neutral) hue, chroma and tones.

change.summary: The choice changed -- a drag in the picker, a swatch, a number typed (vocabulary 1.1.5 §5.1: sf-theme-change → change on the theme generator); the browser's name, with the theme in the detail

sf-theme-generator-committed.summary: The choice was committed -- the picker's change, a swatch, Enter or leaving a field, Reset: the theme the host keeps

sf-theme-generator-change.summary: The choice moved: a drag across the picker, a swatch, a number typed in a field.

value.description: The chosen colour, '' while the Framework's own one applies.

variables.description: The 144 custom properties of the four theme palettes -- 64 tones and 80 translucent steps -- {name: value}.

css.description: The theme as a rule under `selector`.

checks.description: The theme's checks (core themeChecks): {code: contrast|adjusted|close-to-status|grey, level: error|warning|notice, and the check's numbers}.

accessibility.focus: The colour control, Reset, the «Advanced» disclosure and its two number fields are in the focus order; Enter in a field commits the theme. The preview is a named region of labelled swatches, each giving its palette, tone and hex.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-theme-generator where a person chooses a site's or a product's main colour and the rest of its palette should follow.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not copy the palette calculation; import core theme-palette
Do not expect the component to store the choice; the host keeps it
